title: Hierarchical multi-timescale structural dynamics of the disordered N-terminal of p53.
authors: Szollosi, Daniel; Pratihar, Supriya; Mukhopadhyay, Dwaipayan; Rout, Ashok Kumar; Han, Mookyoung; Reddy, G Jithender; Ebersberger, Niklas; Becker, Stefan; Nagy, Gabor; Rauscher, Sarah; Lee, Donghan; Klement, Reinhard; Griesinger, Christian; Grubmuller, Helmut
one_liner_zh: 该文结合NMR与大规模MD模拟研究p53-TAD无序区的多时间尺度结构动态，虽非直接TF-DNA结合体系，但为转录因子无序结构域与DNA/蛋白互作的结构动态机制提供了可借鉴的物理模拟方法。
abstract: Most natively folded proteins exhibit a unique spatial structure, which undergoes functional motions ranging from picoseconds to seconds, governed by a hierarchically ordered, funnel-shaped free energy landscape. Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) lack such a stable native structure, but undergo fast interconversions between many different structures. Accordingly, the underlying free energy landscape is assumed to be rather shallow and unstructured. However, although IDPs represent nearly one-third of the human proteome, their structural dynamics on timescales slower than nanoseconds remain largely elusive. Here we reveal the structural dynamics of the prototypical IDP p53-TAD, also known as the "guardian of the genome", by combining high-power relaxation dispersion nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy with large-scale molecular dynamics simulations. We found a complex hierarchy of structural dynamics on timescales covering over seven orders of magnitude, ranging from fast nanoseconds backbone reorientations, via sub-microsecond helix-formation dynamics involving many structural sub-states and transition times, to transient tertiary structure formation slower than 25 microseconds. These rich structural dynamics are unexpectedly similar to the timescale hierarchy of natively folded proteins, which may be key to the ability of p53-TAD - and possibly of other IDPs - to bind many different partners by folding into different structures.
abstract_zh: 大多数天然折叠蛋白展现出独特的空间结构，其功能运动跨越从皮秒到秒的时间尺度，受控于一个层级有序、漏斗形的自由能景观。固有无序蛋白（IDPs）缺乏这种稳定的天然结构，而是在多种不同结构之间快速互变。因此，其底层自由能景观被认为相对平坦且无结构。然而，尽管IDPs约占人类蛋白质组的近三分之一，它们在纳秒以上时间尺度的结构动力学仍大多未知。在此，我们通过结合高功率弛豫分散核磁共振波谱与大规模分子动力学模拟，揭示了典型IDP p53-TAD（亦称为“基因组守护者”）的结构动力学。我们发现了跨越七个数量级以上的复杂结构动力学层级，涵盖从快速纳秒级骨架重定向，经亚微秒级涉及多种结构亚态和转变时间的螺旋形成动力学，到慢于25微秒的瞬态三级结构形成。这些丰富的结构动力学与天然折叠蛋白的时间尺度层级出人意料地相似，这可能正是p53-TAD——以及可能其他IDPs——通过折叠成不同结构来结合多种不同伙伴的能力的关键所在。
